segments.sn11.5:1.3: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asurindo sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn11.5:1.6: Atha kho, bhikkhave, devā ca asurā ca pārisajje ṭhapesuṃ –
segments.sn11.5:1.8: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacittiṃ asurindo sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn11.5:1.10: Evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo vepacitti asurindaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn11.5:1.13: Evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, vepacitti asurindo imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.sn11.5:3.1: “Bhāsitāya kho pana, bhikkhave, vepacittinā asurindena gāthāya asurā anumodiṃsu, devā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
segments.sn11.5:3.2: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asurindo sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn11.5:3.4: Evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.sn11.5:5.1: “Bhāsitāya kho pana, bhikkhave, sakkena devānamindena gāthāya, devā anumodiṃsu, asurā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
segments.sn11.5:5.2: Atha kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo vepacittiṃ asurindaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn11.5:5.4: Evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, vepacitti asurindo imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.sn11.5:7.1: “Bhāsitāya kho pana, bhikkhave, vepacittinā asurindena gāthāya asurā anumodiṃsu, devā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
segments.sn11.5:7.2: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asurindo sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn11.5:7.4: Evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.sn11.5:14.1: “Bhāsitāsu kho pana, bhikkhave, sakkena devānamindena gāthāsu, devā anumodiṃsu, asurā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
segments.sn11.5:14.2: Atha kho, bhikkhave, devānañca asurānañca pārisajjā etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn11.5:14.4: Tā ca kho sadaṇḍāvacarā sasatthāvacarā, iti bhaṇḍanaṃ iti viggaho iti kalaho.
segments.sn11.5:14.5: Bhāsitā kho [bhāsitā kho pana (sī.)] sakkena devānamindena gāthāyo.
segments.sn11.5:14.6: Tā ca kho adaṇḍāvacarā asatthāvacarā, iti abhaṇḍanaṃ iti aviggaho iti akalaho.
segments.sn11.5:14.8: Iti kho, bhikkhave sakkassa devānamindassa subhāsitena jayo ahosī”ti.

lines: Pañcame asurindaṃ etadavocāti chekatāya etaṃ avoca.
Evaṃ kirassa ahosi “parassa nāma gāhaṃ mocetvā paṭhamaṃ vattuṃ garu.
Parassa vacanaṃ anugantvā pana pacchā sukhaṃ vattun”ti.
Pubbadevāti devaloke ciranivāsino pubbasāmikā, tumhākaṃ tāva paveṇiāgataṃ bhaṇathāti.
Adaṇḍāvacarāti daṇḍāvacaraṇarahitā, daṇḍaṃ vā satthaṃ vā gahetabbanti evamettha natthīti attho.
Pañcamaṃ.
Subhāsitajayasuttavaṇṇanā
“Chekatāyā”ti vatvā tassa vattuṃ chekabhāvaṃ dassetuṃ “evaṃ kirassā”tiādimāha.
Gāhanti laddhiṃ.
Mocetvāti yassa puna “coro”ti uttari vattuṃ na sakkoti, evaṃ vimocetvāti paṭhamaṃ vattuṃ na sakkā.
Garūti bhāriyaṃ, dukkaranti attho.
Pacchāti “parassā”ti vutto so kiñci paṭhamaṃ vadanto attano adhippāyaṃ pavedeti nāma, taṃ yathāsatti viditamano tassa uttari vattuṃ sakkoti.
Tenāha “parassa vacanaṃ anugantvā pana pacchā sukhaṃ vattun”ti.
Api ca asurindena “hotu, devānaminda, subhāsitena jayo”ti paṭhamaṃ vuttaṃ, viseso ca pubbaṃ upanentaṃ anuvattati.
Vacasi kusalo sakko devarājā taṃ visesaṃ teneva pubbaṃ upanayāpento upalāpanavasena “tumhe khvetthā”tiādimāha.
Pubbadevāti sakkapamukhāya devaparisāya loke pubbeva uppannattā “pubbadevā”ti pasaṃsavacanaṃ.
Vepacittiṃ sandhāya “tumhe”ti “pubbadevā”ti ca vuttattā “tumhākaṃ tāva paveṇiāgataṃ bhaṇathā”ti vuttaṃ.
Gāravaṭṭhāniyattā vepacittino bahuvacanapayogo.
Daṇḍena avacāro avacaraṇaṃ daṇḍāvacaro, natthi ettha vutto daṇḍāvacaroti adaṇḍāvacarā, sakkena vuttā gāthāyo.
Vepacittisuttavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā.
Subhāsitajayasuttavaṇṇanā
